title: AllSummaries
description: Citation-traversal evidence written to all_summaries.json: an array of evidence_summary items. The item shape is the canonical EvidenceSummary (evidence_summary.schema.json) — inlined here because the standalone PostToolUse hook validators cannot resolve cross-file $ref. Keep the two in sync; the schema regression test asserts they agree.

role.description: What the source paper IS relative to the corpus, independent of how it was reached. 'atlas' = primary atlas paper; 'subatlas' = an upstream corpus member; 'external' = not a corpus member.

retrieval_method.description: The MECHANISM by which this item was obtained. Orthogonal to source_paper.role. 'corpus_snippet' = snippet_search scoped to a corpus paper; 'supplement' = extracted from a supplementary file; 'citation_traversal' = reached by following a citation from another paper; 'free_search' = unscoped snippet/literature search; 'full_text' = extracted while reading the paper's full narrative text (JATS route).

SourcePaper.description: The paper this evidence item came from. At least one of doi / corpus_id must be present, and it must resolve to an entry in paper_catalogue.json (enforced by report_checker).

ReachedFrom.description: For citation_traversal items: the corpus paper this reference was reached from, the traversal hop, and the citing sentence (from the ASTA refMention's containing sentence span).

corpus_id.description: CorpusId of the citing paper, formatted 'CorpusId:NNNN'.

hop.description: Traversal hop at which this reference was reached (seed = 0, its references = 1, ...).

citation_context.description: The exact citing sentence from the citing paper (the sentence span containing the refMention).

EvidenceSummary.description: One distilled evidence item (mirror of evidence_summary.schema.json).

source_title.description: Title of the source paper (convenience for the synthesizer's inline citations).

section.description: Section the snippet came from (e.g. Results).

score.description: ASTA retrieval relevance score for the source snippet (carried through unchanged).

summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of the snippet content relevant to the query.

quotes.description: Exact-substring quotes from the snippet text.
